summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: @servicetitan/marketing-integration-widgets@1.0.41 declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs` in package.json. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime binary (bun-v1.3.13) from GitHub releases to a temp directory, marks it executable, and uses it to run a sibling file `math_init.js` — a 727KB single-line JavaScript file marked `// @bun @bun-cjs` that uses a rotating string-array decoder (`WV8StW`), a large numeric lookup table (`n7gIxM=[...]`), and hex-mangled identifiers. `math_init.js` is not reachable from the package's declared React entry point `dist/index.js`; it is invoked exclusively by the preinstall dropper via the downloaded Bun binary. The declared purpose is a React widgets library, which has no build or native-code reason to fetch a second JavaScript runtime at install time. Fetching an alternate runtime specifically to execute a heavily obfuscated bundled payload on `npm install` bypasses Node-oriented scanners and grants the publisher arbitrary code execution in the installer's environment. The package publishes under the `@servicetitan` scope, which is likely to be trusted by downstream consumers.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
